generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a C++20 command-line G-code simulator skeleton in `output/` that parses RS274-style blocks (including `#<n>=...` parameter assignments and bracket expressions), executes a basic modal state machine, simulates `G0/G1` linear motion + `G4` dwell + `G53` + `G92*`, supports `--tool-table`, `--parameter-input/--parameter-output`, `--block-delete`, and writes result JSON plus optional trace JSON.

- Build: `cmake -B output/build -S output && cmake --build output/build`
- Entry point: `output/src/main.cpp`
- Core execution: `output/src/simulator.cpp`
- JSON/trace serialization: `output/src/json.*`, `output/src/trace.*`

Limitations: this is not yet a complete implementation of `docs/RS274NGC.md` (notably arcs `G2/G3`, canned cycles `G81–G89` incl. `G83/G87/G88`, full coordinate-system set `G59.1–G59.3`, full tool-length/cutter-comp geometry, and full probe-trip path handling are not implemented).

comparison.note: Same node IDs can have corrected fixtures/assertions; transitions describe these rubric revisions, not repeated trials of an unchanged test suite.

provenance.availability: Portable score summary, not a complete regrade bundle. Raw regrade JSON, source/test snapshots and pytest reports were produced in a scratch working directory on the auditing workstation and are not committed.
